## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-4003. **The issue:** When cart-service was moved to the new Helm chart template in version 4.2, the pod labels changed from `app: cart-service` to the standard format `app.kubernetes.io/name: cart-service` and `app.kubernetes.io/instance: cart-service`, but the Service selector was never updated. This prevented the Service from finding any matching endpoints, causing the "cart unavailable" error.

**The fix:** Update the cart-service Service selector to match the new pod labels (option 1 recommended for best practices alignment).
